answer_4.quote: We built our annotation interface in Amazon MTurk, a crowdsourcing platform. We presented the generated image, the heat map, and the prompt with the target word in red, beside a question asking expert workers to rate how well the highlighting reflects the word.
answer_4.guideline: Rate how well the highlighting reflects the word using a five-point Likert scale: bad, poor, fair, good, excellent; also option to declare image too poor or word too abstract.
